title: Delicious Deep-Fried British Fish
description: Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, this dish is a delight to the senses. Enjoy with a side of mushy peas for a quintessential British experience.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: Cod or Haddock work well for this dish

ingredients.name: Self-Raising Flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use gluten-free flour for a gluten-friendly version

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.notes: Cracked into the batter for added moisture

ingredients.name: Buttermilk
ingredients.notes: Makes the batter light and airy

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg and buttermilk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth.
Add the fish fillets to the batter and coat evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Deep-fry the battered fish for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried fish from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Strain the used oil into a separate container and discard.
Heat the vegetable oil in the same pan to 350°F (175°C).
Add the remaining batter to the pan and fry for 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried batter from the oil and place on top of the fried fish.
